composition_variation: Portray Hitori Gotoh from Bocchi the Rock seated in a tidy bedroom music corner, fully covered in her recognizable loose pink tracksuit. A black electric guitar rests peacefully across her lap, with both hands relaxed and anatomically clear. Use soft lo-fi anime shading, blush pink and midnight-blue tones, a small amber lamp, and a shy hopeful smile. Keep instrument branding and sheet lettering absent. Build an original peaceful portrait wallpaper, never a replica of existing artwork. Keep the upper 28% empty and quiet for the clock. Design at 1024x1536 for the central x158-866 crop, with the face inside x240-784. No text, logos, UI, weapons, violence, or extra characters.

postprocessing.note: Unmodified native PNG preserved in Codex local artifact directory anime-wallpapers-100/native. Final wallpaper is cropped and resized, not generated natively at final dimensions.
